skipped: the data-root checks (use without --skip-data-root to run them)

independent_reviews.scope: core modules (memory, charters, tasks, decisions, teams, models)
independent_reviews.note: Independent review of core modules found 17 findings across version fencing, idempotency, scope authorization, purge key destruction, snapshot recovery and routing cost-honesty; all 17 were fixed before this audit and the full suite passes with zero failures.
Re-check of the fixed areas found 5 remaining issues; all 5 fixed and re-verified by re-running PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests (184 tests, OK).

independent_reviews.scope: release artefacts (README, INSTALL, STATE, coverage, audit, CI, scripts)
independent_reviews.note: The release review found a contradictory verifier receipt, a checks_run list that named skipped checks, an MCP entry pointing at a module that did not exist and was never written into the host config, a rollback that could delete a user file, a README that overstated the scripts folder, a filename-only secret scan, a CI leak rule that exempted the file that leaked, and two corrupted README sentences. All were fixed and re-verified.

limits: The verifier's leak scan matches known path fragments and credential shapes; it is a guard against accidents, not a proof that no secret exists.
The four host surfaces are not verified on installed registered copies: only OpenCode CLI-level code and the MCP surface exist; OpenCode Desktop, pi CLI and PI-Desktop are NOT_VERIFIED
Tests deliberately use no network, subprocess, or wall-clock assertions; they prove module contracts, not live host behavior
Professional domain validation for specialist branches (SCI, VIS and others) has not been executed end to end
No release archive or publication was made by this audit
release_reason: Not ready for publication as complete V1 because professional domain validation and the four host-surface verifications are missing, although the core is releasable as a foundation.
